entry.name: NVIDIA Certification Program
entry.note: Generative AI LLM and infrastructure tracks from the hardware vendor itself

covers: Deploying, configuring, and validating advanced NVIDIA AI infrastructure
Monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing NVIDIA AI infrastructure
Deploying and configuring environments using NVIDIA networking technologies
Foundational concepts of AI computing related to infrastructure and operations
GPU-accelerated tools and libraries for data science workflows
GPU-accelerated data science concepts for data preparation, model development, and end-to-end workflows
Designing, training, and optimizing LLMs with distributed training and fine-tuning
Building and governing agentic AI solutions with multi-agent interaction, scalability, and ethical safeguards
reading.summary: The NVIDIA Certification Program offers credentials that validate skills and expertise across AI infrastructure, networking, data science, large language models, agentic AI, generative AI applications, and multimodal AI systems. The page states that certification provides tangible evidence of expertise, proficiency, and commitment to continuous learning. It is presented as a way to showcase skills and advance a career.
reading.audience: The page says it is for both seasoned professionals and those just starting their journey in the industry.
